prompt: Compose an original complete 60-second instrumental cue for modern material and design close-ups. Instruments: guzheng, plucked bass, dry electronic percussion. 118 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a rising fourth followed by a descending step. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: A lively and upbeat instrumental track featuring a prominent accordion melody over a driving drum beat and bassline, complemented by pizzicato strings and light percussion. It evokes a festive, folk-dance atmosphere with a playful and energetic feel.
description.zh: 一首活泼欢快的器乐曲，手风琴旋律突出，配以强劲的鼓点和低音线，并辅以拨弦乐器和轻快的打击乐。整体营造出节日般的民间舞蹈氛围，充满俏皮和活力。

description.en: An upbeat and energetic electronic track featuring a driving synth bass, a catchy plucked synth melody, and a steady drum beat. It has a playful and positive vibe.
description.zh: 一首欢快且充满活力的电子音乐，以强劲的合成器贝斯、抓耳的拨弦合成器旋律和稳定的鼓点为特色。它带有一种俏皮和积极的氛围。
